description: Rewrite the accounting page (frontend/src/app/admin/accounting/page.tsx) to add: (1) Date range filter with JalaliDatePicker defaulting to current Jalali month, sending date range to Odoo query. (2) Partner/person dropdown filter that filters account.move by partner_id server-side. (3) Replace the hardcoded DocReason dropdown with a dynamic chart-of-accounts dropdown fetched via getExpenseIncomeAccounts(), using destination_account_id on account.payment. Keep the partner option so users can pick a partner AND an account.
steps: In frontend/src/app/admin/accounting/page.tsx, import getExpenseIncomeAccounts from odoo-api.ts and import jalaali-js for Jalali date computation

Add state for dateFrom/dateTo (ISO strings), defaulting to the start and end of the current Jalali month. Use jalaali.toJalaali(now) to get current Jalali year/month, then jalaali.toGregorian(jy, jm, 1) for start, and jalaali.toGregorian(jy, jm+1, 1) minus 1 day or jalaali.jalaaliMonthLength(jy, jm) for end
Add state for accounts (fetched from getExpenseIncomeAccounts) and replace DocReason type with account-based selection
Add a filter bar above the entries list with two JalaliDatePicker fields (from/to) and a partner dropdown populated from the existing partners state
Modify fetchEntries() to include date range in the Odoo domain: ['date', '>=', dateFrom], ['date', '<=', dateTo]. Also add ['partner_id', '=', filterPartnerId] if filterPartnerId > 0

Replace the 'reason' select in the form modal with a dynamic account dropdown. Fetch accounts on mount using getExpenseIncomeAccounts(). Display account name (e.g., 'هزینه پیک', 'اجاره', 'حقوق') in the dropdown. Store selected account_id in form state
In handleSubmit(), add destination_account_id: form.account_id to the account.payment creation data when an account is selected
Keep the partner_id field in the form visible always (not just when reason=partner). Allow users to optionally select a partner AND an account
Remove the old DocReason type, REASON_LABELS constant, and related hardcoded logic
Update quick action cards to pre-select appropriate accounts instead of reasons (e.g., the delivery expense card should preselect the delivery expense account if found)
acceptance_criteria: The accounting page shows two JalaliDatePicker fields for date filtering, defaulting to the current Jalali month
A partner dropdown filter is visible that sends partner_id filter to Odoo
The form modal has a dynamic accounts dropdown fetched from Odoo instead of hardcoded DocReason
The form sends destination_account_id when creating account.payment
Users can select both a partner and an account simultaneously
`npm run build` passes with no TypeScript errors
findings: Build passes cleanly with all 18 static pages. Used jalaali-js getCurrentJalaliMonthRange() helper for default date range. The useEffect for fetchEntries depends on dateFrom/dateTo/filterPartnerId to trigger server-side refetch. Removed DocReason type and REASON_LABELS entirely. Quick action cards use findAccountByKeyword() to preselect matching accounts - will silently fall back to 0 if no match found in the fetched accounts.
